# @ratmath/algebraic

> Exact algebraic numbers (real and complex), exact trigonometry, polynomial factoring, Galois groups, continued fractions, number fields and finite fields for RatMath. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as algebraic from "@ratmath/algebraic"`.

Built from 0.1.0, commit 92bae17. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/algebraic/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/algebraic/blob/92bae17/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/algebraic/. Full types: index.d.ts.

Types: `type Pair = [bigint, bigint]`; `type RationalLike = Pair | Rational | bigint | number | string`; `type IntPoly = bigint[]`; `type PolyLike = RationalLike[]`; `type PairInterval = [Pair, Pair]`; `type Algebraic = AlgebraicReal | ComplexAlgebraic`; `type FieldArg = NumberFieldElement | RationalLike`; `type Permutation = number[]`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/algebraic/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Overview), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), numbers (Algebraic numbers), complex (Complex numbers), angles (Angles and roots of unity), recognize (Recognising numbers), factoring (Factoring), polynomials (Polynomial toolkit), galois (Galois groups), number-fields (Number fields), finite-fields (Finite fields)

## API

name(params) → result — meaning · file:line · docs page

- `AlgebraicReal class: rational, poly, lo, hi, refine, isRational, interval, toRational, toNumber` — A real algebraic number: a root of the square-free integer polynomial `poly` in the open interval (lo, hi), or an exact rational. · src/poly.js:253
- `isolate(p: IntPoly) → AlgebraicReal[]` — Isolate the real roots of a square-free polynomial, ascending. · src/poly.js:195
- `countRealRoots(p: IntPoly) → number` — Count of distinct real roots of a square-free polynomial. · src/poly.js:189
- `squareFree(p: IntPoly) → Array<{ factor: IntPoly; multiplicity: number }>` — Yun's square-free factorisation: [{ factor, multiplicity }], factors primitive, nonconstant. · src/poly.js:131
- `simplestBetween(a: Pair, b: Pair) → Pair` — The fraction with the smallest denominator in [a, b] (a ≤ b). · src/poly.js:238
- `ComplexAlgebraic class: poly, re, im, conjugate, refine, box, toNumbers, toDecimal, toString, imSign` — A complex algebraic number: the unique root of the square-free integer polynomial `poly` in the box re × im (each [lo, hi] of pairs). · src/complex.js:77
- `certifyComplexRoots(p: IntPoly, count: number) → ComplexAlgebraic[] | null` — Certified non-real roots of a square-free integer polynomial, given how many there are (from a Sturm count). · src/complex.js:172
- `fromRational(x: RationalLike) → AlgebraicReal` — A rational (pair [n, d], Core Rational, bigint, number or string) as an AlgebraicReal. · src/arith.js:29 · numbers

- `roots(coeffs: PolyLike, options?: { complex?: boolean }) → Array<{ value: Algebraic; multiplicity: number }>` — All roots of an integer or rational polynomial (coefficients constant first, as bigints, pairs or Rationals), each with its multiplicity. · src/arith.js:62 · complex
- `realRoots(coeffs: PolyLike) → Array<{ value: AlgebraicReal; multiplicity: number }>` — Real roots only (shorthand for roots(p)). · src/arith.js:88
- `minimalPolynomial(a: Algebraic) → IntPoly` — The minimal polynomial of a (primitive integer, constant first). · src/arith.js:91 · numbers
- `simplify(a: T) → T` — The same number, re-expressed on its minimal polynomial. · src/arith.js:100

- `sqrtMod(a: bigint, p: bigint) → bigint | null` — A square root of a modulo an odd prime p (Tonelli–Shanks), the smaller of the two; null when a is not a square. · src/nt.js:65 · finite-fields
- `primitiveRoot(p: bigint) → bigint` — The least primitive root modulo a prime p. · src/nt.js:141
- `multiplicativeOrder(a: bigint, n: bigint) → bigint` — The order of a in (Z/nZ)ˣ: the least k > 0 with aᵏ ≡ 1. · src/nt.js:127
- `discreteLogMod(g: bigint, h: bigint, p: bigint) → bigint | null` — The least x ≥ 0 with gˣ ≡ h (mod p), p prime, or null. · src/nt.js:186 · finite-fields
- `totient(n: bigint) → bigint` — Euler's φ(n). · src/nt.js:120

- `galoisAction(coeffs: PolyLike) → GaloisAction` — The Galois group of an irreducible polynomial of degree ≤ 7 as permutations of its roots. · src/galois.js:792 · galois

- `PermGroup class: symmetric, alternating, from, degree, generators, order, isTransitive, isAbelian, isCyclic, isEven, isSolvable, has, contains, equals, orbits, orbitsOnSets, cycleTypes, subgroup, conjugate, isNormal, cosets, derivedSubgroup, derivedSeries, withSmallGenerators, subgroupClasses, toString` · src/permgroup.js:96
- `cycleString(p: Permutation) → string` — Cycle notation counted from 1: "(1 2 3)(4 5)", and "()" for the identity. · src/permgroup.js:34
- `fromCycles(text: string, n: number) → Permutation` — Reads "(1 2 3)(4 5)" as a permutation of n points. · src/permgroup.js:40
- `cycleType(p: Permutation) → number[]` — The cycle type, a partition of n such as [3, 2, 1, 1]. · src/permgroup.js:31

## Namespaces

- `poly` (src/poly.js): degree, trim, primitive, fromPairs, derivative, signAt, evalAt, polyGcd, divide, squareFree, countRealRoots, isolate, simplestBetween, AlgebraicReal, countRootsBetween, Rational
- `qpoly` (src/qpoly.js): isZeroQ, trimQ, degQ, isZeroPoly, addP, subP, mulP, divmodP, modP, monicP, gcdP, scaleP, constP, xP, toIntPoly, fromIntPoly, evalP, formatP, reduce
- `interval` (src/interval.js): iv, toCore, ivAdd, ivSub, ivMul, ivMid, ivWidth, ivInside, ivIntersect, outward, krawczykStep, krawczyk, Rational
- `polys` (src/polys.js): add, sub, mul, divmod, gcd, gcdExt, evaluate, compose, derivative, fromRoots, toInteger, format, resultant, discriminant, countRoots, interpolate, partialFractions, derivativeInt
- `nt` (src/nt.js): egcd, modInverse, modPow, jacobi, sqrtMod, factorInteger, totient, multiplicativeOrder, orderIn, primitiveRoot, discreteLog, discreteLogMod, isProbablePrime

## Example

```js
import { fromRational, roots, add, mul, sqrt, format, cosPi, galoisGroup } from "@ratmath/algebraic";
const r2 = sqrt(fromRational(2));
const s = add(r2, sqrt(fromRational(3)));
console.log("√2 + √3 =", s.toString(20));
console.log("its minimal polynomial (constant first):", s.poly);
console.log("(√2 + √3)² =", format(mul(s, s)));
console.log("cos(π/5) =", format(cosPi("1/5")));
console.log("roots of x³ − 2:", roots([-2, 0, 0, 1], { complex: true }).map((r) => format(r.value)));
galoisGroup([-2, 0, 0, 0, 1]).name
```
